property_summary: For any owner-configured fee and any contract asset, after withdrawFees(asset, recipient) the total supply/balance backing of the asset held by c must decrease by exactly the amount cleared from unclaimedFees[asset]; the mutant clears the accounting without transferring tokens, so c's asset holdings stay unchanged while unclaimedFees goes to zero.
change_summary: Remove the ERC20 transfer so the accumulated fee balance is cleared but the tokens are never sent.
